AlternateTargets: the case of Luzu facing the wall

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Luzu faces the wall names a recurrent case-action: when a visitor came, Luzu turned and faced the wall. Later masters repeatedly ask for its intent, answer with unrelated-looking phrases, reject proposed explanations, and compose verses under the case title.
EvidenceBody: Later questioners repeatedly ask ‘what is the intent of Luzu facing the wall?’ Zifu Rubao answers that it has no connection; Huilin Hongji asks what there is to explain; Zhu'an Shigui answers with the five phases and celestial bodies.

Verse collections preserve “Luzu faces the wall” as a case heading, while a later appraisal gives Luzu and Mazu's closed door twenty blows. These are public re-raisings of one remembered action, not descriptions of private contemplation.

Senses.Note: Seven witnesses span direct case questions, rejecting answers, a case-title verse, and explicit later appraisal of the action.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: Wall-facing is preserved as Luzu's public response to visitors, not as a generic instruction for seated practice.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The witnesses attest the action and its later interrogation; they do not establish a private mental state behind Luzu's turn.

ComparedThings: Luzu's reported act of turning to face a wall when visitors came
later case titles and questions that name that same act
DifferentThingTest.Reason: Title, question, and verse all point to the same transported event; they are not distinct senses of wall-facing.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Aliases name Luzu and wall-facing in natural English so a reader can find the case without already knowing the Chinese word order.

ModifierControls.Finding: The personal name is essential: the headword is the Luzu case, not every instance of facing a wall.
The action is visible wall-facing; the selected corpus does not authorize replacing it with ‘meditation.’

FamilyControls.Finding: Bare wall-facing has a wider Bodhidharma and posture family; this entry is restricted to Luzu's case.
Narrative variants describing Luzu turning away belong to the same case but are not silently substituted for the exact heading.
